content:
Everyone struggling with fixing the belts to the nextruder holder, follow this tip:

Insert a zip tie through the linear rail mount screw holes (2 left; in the first picture: one below the thumb). Once you have aligned the length to be flush with the holder, you can pull the zip tie close and basically forget about it until you mount the thing to the linear rail. And since its mounted in the screw holes, you won't forget about the zip accidentally.

The original belts would use a measurement such as “4 to 5 teeth” to leave hanging. Gen 2 upgrade changes this to be flush with the metal and I think this is a better way to make sure the belt lengths are pulled to the right length. My orignal belt kept slipping teeth, but I guess 3 to 2 teeth tolerance was enough for the old belt
